parameters.content:
# 📝 FLOW 1A: Serve Employee Form
GET /employee-form → fetch all employees → build HTML → serve as text/html

# 📤 FLOW 1B: Submit Leave Request
POST /submit-leave-request → validate → check balance → append to sheet → email manager

# 👤 FLOW 2A: Serve Manager Approval Form
GET /manager-approval-form?requestId=X → fetch request+employee → build HTML → serve

# ✅ FLOW 2B: Manager Decision
POST /submit-manager-decision → validate → update table_1 → if approved: email HR, if rejected: email employee

# 🏛️ FLOW 3A: Serve HR Approval Form
GET /hr-approval-form?requestId=X → fetch request+employee → build HTML → serve

# 🏁 FLOW 3B: HR Final Decision
POST /submit-hr-decision → validate → update table_1 → if approved: deduct balance + email employee, if rejected: email employee
